t: Titanium-coated blades providing increased durability and longer edge life. Features serrated bottom blade that grips material for a more controlled, cleaner cut. Fitted with soft grip TPR handles for comfort and control with an offset design for easier tablework cutting. Index finger 'control channel' to improve cutting power and increase stability. Ideal for cutting heavy fabric, leather, carboard, plastic and more.
